text: {"lessons":["I should judge each holding by its prospects and role in my portfolio, not by whether it is above or below my purchase price; refusing to admit a mistake can make a loss worse.","Selling Stock B and Stock D at gains felt reassuring, but I should not automatically take profits while letting losing positions ride. I need consistent, forward-looking rules for both buying and selling.","These price moves do not predict what comes next. I should focus on my overall risk and make deliberate decisions rather than react to daily fluctuations or let losses weigh twice as heavily as gains."]}
